scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run setup:env && npm run seed
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix packages/myskanilan-sdk install && npm --prefix packages/myskanilan-sdk run build && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix apps/merchant-pos install && npm --prefix apps/portal-web install
scripts.build:all: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:backend && npm run build:pos && npm run build:portal
scripts.setup:env: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('backend/.env') && fs.existsSync('backend/.env.example')) { fs.copyFileSync('backend/.env.example', 'backend/.env'); console.log('Created backend/.env from .env.example'); }"
